boundary.definition: A line you draw around your time, energy, body or values, and say out loud so other people can respect it.
boundary.example: Her boundary was simple: no phone calls after ten.

dm_hypergamy.definition: Pairing with a person who has more of a valued resource, such as income, education or position, than the chooser.
dm_hypergamy.example: Hypergamy names the direction of the pairing, and the direction can be read from either side.

grace_period.definition: The days between the statement date and the due date, during which you can pay in full without interest.
grace_period.example: If I pay the statement balance inside the grace period, I pay no interest.

omnivore.definition: An animal that eats both plants and animals, such as a bear, a pig or a person.
omnivore.example: We are omnivores, so we eat rice and fish.
